Open a campus or district's Texas School Report Card

txs_open_src.Rd

Since 2020, TEA publishes School Report Cards exclusively at https://txschools.gov – a JavaScript application this package cannot scrape (see txs_get_src() for the parsed 2004-2019 archive). This function is the complement for anything txs_get_src() cannot reach: it does not download or parse anything, it just launches the right page in a browser.

Usage

txs_open_src(
  geography,
  level = c("campus", "district"),
  tab = "overview",
  browse = TRUE
)

Arguments

geography

A single campus (9-digit) or district (6-digit) number, quoted to preserve leading zeros.

level

"campus" or "district".

tab

Which tab of the report card to land on – TEA-defined, e.g. "overview", "academic", "stakeholder-and-community-input", or (district level) "schools" to list its campuses.

browse

If TRUE (the default), open the URL with utils::browseURL(). Set FALSE to only build the URL, e.g. for scripting or testing.

Value

Invisibly, the URL.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
txs_open_src("161920102")                     # China Spring Elementary
txs_open_src("161920", level = "district")     # China Spring ISD
} # }
